text:
Sara (Support): Heads-up — QuillCare opened a support ticket asking for streaming completions that emit incremental function-call events to a customer webhook, plus a final reconciled JSON object. They want downstream processing to begin before the full output is ready.

Lana (Sales): Customer says peak bursts ~400 qps, steady 40 rps. Wants <250ms per chunk and delivery guarantees. They're willing to sign an enterprise deal if we can provide a beta SLA.

Alex (Product): Clarifying questions: do they require resumable resume tokens after disconnects? Are partial events guaranteed to be well-formed JSON fragments or typed deltas? Will they accept a separate "finalized" event to indicate reconciliation?

Sara (Support): They prefer resumable streams with resume_token. Partial events can be typed deltas (e.g., add/append/replace) and they want a final "final_output" event. Prefer webhook push (HTTP POST with event metadata) over long-lived WS.

Devon (Eng): Implementation notes: we currently stream tokens and a single end fncall. For partial fncall events we need explicit event framing (fncall.start, fncall.update, fncall.finish), resume tokens, and idempotency keys for replay. Rough estimate: 2 wks spec + 3-5 wks implementation + 1 wk SDK/docs + canary. Main risks: replay duplication, ordering on retries, and webhook backpressure.

Priya (Security): Need to confirm webhook signing, optional per-request HMAC, and support for stripping/redacting PII before delivery. Also privacy review for storing partial payloads.

Alex (Product): Draft beta acceptance criteria:
- API can emit fncall.start / fncall.update / fncall.finish events to webhook (deterministic event types)
- Resume token issued at safe checkpoints; replay is idempotent
- Final output event with server-side schema validation and explicit error codes
- Webhook delivery supports retries, exponential backoff, and dead-lettering
- SDK client helpers (Python + TS) to handle reconnect/replay
- Security: signed webhook + optional PII redaction hook

Lana (Sales): QuillCare asked for a 6–8 week timeline. Can we hit beta in 6? They prefer webhook-only initially.

Devon (Eng): We can aim for a webhook-only beta in 6 weeks if we restrict to one model family (v2.x) and do not include on-prem. Full feature set (ws, multi-model, DLQ UI) will be 10–12 weeks.

Priya (Security): PII redaction as a pre-delivery filter is feasible but adds ~4 business days for review and e2e tests. Webhook signing implementation is small but needs key rotation design.

Alex (Product): Proposed scope for roadmap ticket: "Partial fncall streaming + final validated JSON (webhook beta)". Owner: @Devon. Beta target: 6 weeks (webhook-only, single model family). Non-goals for beta: WS, on-prem, UI DLQ.

Sara (Support): Customer will accept beta if we provide a data handling doc and opt-in redaction. I'll confirm and ask if they can be the canary customer.

ops-bot: Created backlog ticket INF-4801 and assigned to Devon.

Lana (Sales): Sending the beta proposal to QuillCare now, noting the webhook-only constraint.

Devon (Eng): I'll draft an RFC and include event schemas and resume semantics. Need SRE sizing for webhook throughput.

Alex (Product): I'll add acceptance criteria and link INF-4801 to the roadmap card. Marking P0 for this cycle.

Priya (Security): I'll schedule a short review slot; please include sample events and storage retention details.

Sample event sketch Devon pasted:
```
POST /webhooks/quillcare
Headers: { "X-Redwood-Event": "fncall.update", "X-Request-Id": "rq_9x8y" }
Body: {
  "request_id": "rq_9x8y",
  "call_id": "call_331",
  "event_type": "fncall.update",
  "delta": { "path": "items[3]", "op": "append", "value": {"id":"itm_99","status":"pending"} },
  "resume_token": "r_tok_2024_01",
  "checkpoint": 230
}
```
Sara (Support): I'll add the data-handling checklist link and confirm customer can be early canary.

Lana (Sales): Thanks all — I'll follow up with QuillCare timeline expectations. :+1:
